cheat_extended.name: Cheat Extended
notes: DOL-X vega 4.x: v1.20 betaTest is paired with the official maplebirch v4.1.13 release; the >=3.2.5 runtime gate passes

RUNTIME SOFT-GATE (read from the mod's own JS, NOT boot.json): boot.json declares only ModLoader>=2.17.0 / ImageLoaderHook / TweeReplacer / ReplacePatcher / SweetAlert2Mod / GameVersion>=0.5.5.9 -- there is NO maplebirch entry. The framework requirement lives in scriptEarly/framework_detector.js (SweetAlert2 popup if maplebirch mod version < 3.2.5) and scriptEarly/CERegist.js (compareVersions gate; on failure only logger.error runs and all 7 addTo() registrations are skipped, so CE loads as a shell with no UI entry points)
USER VERIFIED 2026-07-28: the Cheat Extended interface opens and one or two sampled functions work; the same run reports 0 error / 0 warning / 340 info
v1.20 targets game 0.5.10.12 and bundles scripts/CE_HeadMaskCompat.js; the visible head-mask compatibility mode belongs to Cheat Extended, not Legacy-Art-Mods-Compat or maplebirch
Official Pre-release is now the primary download source. Per-mod prerelease tracking compares the GitHub asset digest so an in-place replacement under the same tag is detected
XFoxLG/DOL-X cheat-extended-mirror-v1.20 is archive-only manual disaster recovery; its bytes match the current official asset
CORRECTION: an earlier note here claimed the upstream v1.19 Release was deleted -- that was WRONG, v1.19 still exists upstream (197044 bytes, archived locally too)
Rollback: cheat-extended-mirror-v1.18 is kept intact; v1.18 has no framework gate and loads on any maplebirch version
--- v1.18 mirror history (kept for rollback reference) ---
DOL-X: Repacked + re-uploaded the v1.18 mirror (2026-07-05)

Original defect: self-hosted v1.18 mirror zip used Windows BACKSLASH path separators (css\CE_CSS.css), violating the ZIP spec; ModLoader resolves boot.json forward-slash paths so every file failed ('cannot get ... from mod zip'), loading an empty shell that never registered to maplebirch and threw 8 'cannot find replaceFile' errors

Fix (Python zipfile): rewrote all entries with forward slashes; dropped garbage (CE_inventory_helper.twee.bak, PIC/* screenshots, mojibake .jpg); backfilled scriptEarly/Utils/spectrum.{js,css} from clean v1.19; pruned 2 dangling boot.json refs (Widgets State Man_{1,2}.txt, absent upstream in v1.17/v1.18/v1.19 alike)
Result: 63 entries, 0 backslash, all boot.json refs (incl addonPlugin) resolve; CERegist.js + framework_detector.js present so it registers to maplebirch
v1.18 boot.json has NO maplebirch dependency and loads on v3.1.14; provides full Yanling system + brothel basement + customer eye/skin color
Source tag chris81605 V1.18(Dev260325), upstream Release deleted after v1.19 (recoverable via commit history); mirror retained to survive deletion

au_face.name: AU面部扩展
notes: Enabled only for local AU-F/AU-M/AU-A builds after the maplebirch v4.1.13 base stack reached 0 errors and 0 warnings
Never injected into base code 15704320; it is bound to au-f/au-m/au-a feature IDs

Three identities belong to the same official asset: release text v1.0.4, outer wrapper boot.json v1.1.0, and inner decrypted mod v1.2.8; the outer wrapper decrypts its .crypt payload at earlyload and calls lazyRegisterNewModZipData, so ModLoader lists the inner mod as [SideLoadLazy] AU面部扩展 1.2.8
The earlier 3.x-era tests already recorded this outer/inner split; a v1.2.8 lock entry is therefore valid evidence, not an unsourced value
boot.json dependencies: ModLoader ^2.5.1 and SweetAlert2Mod ^1.0.0; no hard maplebirch dependency is declared

AU-F runtime evidence 2026-07-29: settings UI mounts and is interactive, but the inner mod requests legacy blushN/tearN paths while canonical resources use blush-N/tears-N; visual effects remain unverified
No public upload or mirror is authorized by this change; the official author release is the only source

legacy_art_compat.name: 旧版图片名称适配 (Legacy-Art-Mods-Compat plus)
notes: Community plus of mirrormirroronwall/Legacy-Art-Mods-Compat; upstream README explicitly allows modification and redistribution
Plus author: 鎖鏈蝴蝶 @ 百度貼吧 (acknowledged in bundled readme.md)

User runtime evidence 2026-07-29: AU Face blushN/tearN errors disappeared with plus sideloaded; independent mouth posture confirmed working; face pattern and tear visual effects still unverified but not blocking
